features.title: Pure leather upholstery that’s easy to maintain
features.text: Features pure leather upholstery at all touchpoints for unmatched comfort, breathability, and long-term durability for years.

features.title: High-back design that supports all-day comfort
features.text: The tall backrest is ergonomically designed to cradle your back and shoulders, helping you relax in complete comfort no matter the time of day.

features.title: Sink-in foam cushioning that feels just right
features.text: The foam cushions provide the perfect balance of softness and support, giving you that sink-in feel without compromising posture.

features.title: Symmetrical stitching that adds refinement
features.text: Clean, symmetrical stitching elevates the sofa’s design, giving it a polished and contemporary aesthetic.

features.title: Designed for lasting durability
features.text: Incorporates double webbing with S spring and nylon, providing a comfortable seating experience and prolonged lifespan.
